1.title: AI Agents Can Now Automate Global Trade | Evan Smith
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Evan Smith (Altana CEO) discusses how AI agents map opaque global supply chains, reduce trade vulnerabilities, and why logistics giants are adopting autonomous AI brokers; covers enterprise ARR growth and economic security reshaping tech manufacturing.

1.title: How I fight token fraud as an AI founder
1.author: How I AI
1.hook: Solo founder of ChatPRD walks through six token fraud attack patterns (free trial farming, promo code reselling, relay wrapping, custom MCPs as compute workers), business and technical controls including real-time classification via Jev, why she killed free trials, and the operational/financial cost of defending an AI SaaS product.

2.title: Selling AI on Hours Saved Is Dead | Ishan Mukherjee
2.author: MTS
2.hook: Rox CEO on enterprise AI revenue agents: why "hours saved" messaging fails, how to tie agent ROI to board outcomes in 60–90 days, and reskilling frontline workers from task execution to agent orchestration.

3.title: Claude Code Is Still Limited by Human Speed | Shaun Clowes
3.author: MTS
3.hook: Shaun Clowes (IBM/Confluent GM) on why enterprise AI stalls after POC — real-time data infrastructure gap, legacy complexity, timeline to full autonomy (~5 years), and IBM's post-acquisition strategy for agents on streaming data.
